marketingRemarks.marketingRemark: Exceptional opportunity to acquire approximately 20 acres of M-2 (Heavy Industrial) zoned land in one of Merced's premier industrial corridors. Located at 864 E. Childs Avenue, Merced, CA, this property is ideally suited for a truck parking facility, transportation yard, fleet operations, equipment storage, contractor yard, logistics, or other industrial uses permitted under M-2 zoning. The surrounding properties are already established truck parking and industrial operations, making this a natural fit for owner-users and investors alike.    Strategically positioned with excellent access to Highway 99 and major transportation routes, the site offers outstanding connectivity for regional and statewide distribution. Opportunities to acquire large, contiguous M-2 industrial parcels in this location are increasingly limited.    Whether you're expanding an existing trucking operation or developing a new industrial facility, this property offers the size, zoning, and location to support a wide range of commercial and industrial uses (buyer to verify all intended uses with the appropriate agencies)    Conceptual Rendering Disclaimer    The first image in this marketing package is an AI-generated conceptual rendering intended solely to illustrate one potential future development scenario for the property. It does not depict existing improvements and should not be interpreted as an approved site plan or guaranteed future development. All remaining photographs are actual images of the property. Buyers are encouraged to independently verify zoning, permitted uses, utility availability, development requirements, and all other material information through their own due diligence.

My brother is now at weaver middleschool he has also struggling as soon as he moved to Farmdale i saw his improvement. I love this school!

This is my grandson's school. He came to live in Merced last December(2012). He has brought up all of his grades and his attitude and outlook on life has changed for a more positive note, I thank the staff and activities for "bringing him out of his shell"!!!!:)

Great school..... The principal Mrs. Moser has done an outstanding job with the school, it is a very caring environment that enforces basic principles and good behavior, pushes them to improve their academic progress...

I have found that Farmdale has caring teachers and for students there really like the school. They have band after-school programs and extra help available. Of course, there are some students who refuse to perform and have parentsj who don't care. Perhaps the parent above should look in the mirror....She or he is not even able to write a coherent sentance - it reflects on the student.

I've only seen this school through the Challenger Learning Center's participation in their Family Science Nights and their teachers involved with our GEMS Nspires grant program. So based on these experiences, I rate this school 5 stars!

schoolReviews.review: I have 2 students here. The one senior and one freshman. I like that it is the type of school where most students know each other from their younger days and yet, they have been welcoming to students like mine, who are transplants. Parents seem to be engaged, FFA seems great and there are lots of programs, clubs and pathways for students to explore.

This is an amazing campus to work at. I feel supported by both administration and parents, which is not always the case at other schools. I have some of the best kids in the district in my classes and for the most part, they all work hard and do their best. This is a wonderful school!!!

schoolReviews.review: Registration staff is rude and condescending they do not understand that if you do not have the birth certificate you can use other documents and that if they deny a student enrollment into their school based on not having the birth certificate they are in violation of the federal law and several staff members have stated that they are not in violation the federal law they don't have to abide by it and they're all rude disrespectful I would never recommend a child go to the school even if they were desperate and this was the score the only had an available space I would not enroll a child there

My son is in his 3rd year at Charles Wright and my daughter in her 2nd year, and we have had nothing but excellent experiences with all of the teachers, and with the principal, Mrs. Slaven, and Assistant Principal, Mrs. Barber. There is also a very active Parent Teacher Club that has raised several thousand dollars over the past 3 years, money that has been used to improve the playground equipment, provide teachers with supplies and classroom tools, and most importantly, restored the ability of all classes to go on big field trips several times throughout the year! My kids and I love Charles Wright! Staying involved and getting to know the teachers, principals, and staff is key, and has allowed us to benefit from constant support and opportunities to improve. Only a handful of parents come to the PTC meetings, and attendance of school functions by families of students seems low.
